entry.title: Burp Suite: Main Purposes in Web Security Testing
entry.summary: Burp Suite is a web application security testing platform developed by PortSwigger. It is widely used by penetration testers, security researchers, and developers to analyze and test web applications. What is Burp Suite Used For? The main purpose of Burp Suite is to intercept, inspect, modify, and test HTTP/HTTPS traffic between a browser and a web server. Intercept Web Traffic Burp Suite allows testers to capture requests and responses between the client and server. Browser → Burp Suite → Server Test Web Vulnerabilities It can be used to investigate vulnerabilities such as: Broken Access Control Modify and Replay Requests With tools such as Repeater, testers can modify HTTP requests and send them again to observe how the application behaves. Automate Security Testing Intruder can automate customized requests for tasks such as parameter testing and controlled input testing. Analyze Application Behavior Burp Suite helps testers understand: HTTP methods Instead of treating a web application as a black box, Burp Suite allows security testers to see and interact with the application's HTTP communication. It is an essential tool to learn for anyone interested in web application penetration testing and application security.
